title: Gorilla Smack Systems
author: Tj T.
desc:
Build strength and size
This program is every other day if possible.

ex.note:
10 full
10 top half
10 hold
rest 1-2 min

warm up set
8-12 reps
1-2 min rest

heavy cable flies
6-8 reps
2-5 min rest

standard grip
weighted if possible
12 reps max
1-2min rest

lateral grip
weighted if possible
12 reps max
1-2min rest

underhand grip
weighted if possible
12 reps max
1-2min rest

inside hammer curl toward chest.
6-8 reps
2-5 min rest

standing curl finish with bar eye level.
6-8 reps 
2-5 min rest

pull pinkies to roof as pull rope apart
6-8 reps
2-5 min rest

trace the head with bar 
6-8 reps 
2-5 min rest

bent over rear delt flies
6-10 reps
1-2 min rest

10 full
10 top half 
10s top hold
1-2 min rest

ss.note: bottom thumbs face each other at top your palms face each other

ss.n: Incline DB Low To High Chest Fly
Lateral Raise DB Raise Top Partial
Single Arm Pec Dec Rear Flies
Flat Bench Single Arm Skull Chrusher
